_doc: One settlement system for every place people live. tiers: base (the main camp, level = Furnace Level 1-30), outpost (one per region/biome, content comes later), camp (one per opened location/chunk inside a region). A tier's level is capped by its parents: a camp by the base (and by its region's outpost once outposts exist). camp.levels[i] = what level i+1 gives; baseLevel = Furnace Level needed. Costs scale with the chunk's distance from the base: x(1 + distanceCost * (distance - 1)).

camp._buildings: Fixed core of every camp. at = offset from the camp centre; requires = other parts that must stand first. The fire is bought with the 'Found camp' zone.
camp._sites: Where the camp stands in a named chunk (world x, z of its centre). Procedural chunks use the chunk centre.
camp._route: Camp -> base hauling. tiers[0] = sled with a driver, [1] = sled road + reindeer team, [2] = log flume (continuous, no sled). capacity = items per trip (flow: items per minute); every throughput level adds levelBonus. Items above each rule's keep amount are sent; logs go to the base's wood stores (furnace / stall / lumber hut), everything else to the Warehouse.

route._distanceCapacity: Sleds of far camps are bigger: capacity x(1 + distanceCapacity x (distance - 1)), so the long road doesn't eat the richer land's bonus.

camp._workers: Camp worker places = levels[i].workers. The Woodcutters' Hut hires 2 of them. Auto-assign moves a base lumberjack to a camp only when the camp has a route and that lumberjack's recent trips were longer than autoMoveTrip metres. Only while the camp depot is under autoMaxDepotFill full (otherwise the route is the bottleneck and more choppers won't help). Also only if the route can carry one more lumberjack's logs: routeRate >= (camp lumberjacks + 1) x lumberjackRate.
camp._slots: Production slots around the camp centre (offsets). levels[i].slots counts the depot, hut and tower too: slots - 3 are free for workshops.
camp._traits: Character of a location. logMult/hitMult: logs per tree and hits per tree (every chopper). fell: bonus goods per tree felled by camp lumberjacks. gather: what the Gatherers' Hut finds (weights). wildMult: wild animals. huntMult: Hunting Lodge meat & hides. Named chunks are listed in assign; other chunks get a trait from their position. Every step away from the base adds distanceBonus to camp production.

oldpine.name: Old Pine Forest
oldpine.desc: Huge firs: many logs per tree, slow to fell

birch.name: Birch Grove
birch.desc: Birch bark from every tree, birch sap for the gatherers

burnt.name: Burnt Woods
burnt.desc: Charred trees give charcoal without a kiln (fewer logs)

hunting.name: Hunting Grounds
hunting.desc: Plenty of game: more meat and hides — and more bears

camp._workshops: Camp workshops, built from the camp tab into free slots. recipe: in -> out every seconds (from the camp stock). gather: items per minute. regrow: tree regrowth multiplier in the location. hires: camp workers of that kind (count against the camp's places).

sawmill.name: Camp Sawmill
sawmill.desc: Logs → planks on the spot (half the weight to haul)

nursery.name: Tree Nursery
nursery.desc: Plants new trees: the forest here regrows 3x faster

lodge.name: Hunting Lodge
lodge.desc: A hunter works this location; meat and hides go to the camp

gather.name: Gatherers' Hut
gather.desc: Berries, mushrooms, herbs — and what this location is known for

tar.name: Tar Kiln
tar.desc: Resin from logs, then torches and tarred planks

camp._specs: Specialisation, chosen once the camp reaches specLevel: boosts are production keys (fell = bonus goods per tree, log = camp lumberjacks' logs, hunt, gather, workshops by id).
camp._levels: Upgrading to level i+1 costs levels[i].cost: money and planks from the base, food (pie, stew or smoked fish from the Warehouse), logs from the camp (then the bank), plus `signature` of the location's own good (traits.*.signature) from the camp. Every level also adds levelBonus to camp production. Looks: tents up to cabinsAt-1, cabins from cabinsAt, palisade from palisadeAt.
camp._raids: Bears and wolves raid camps. First raid firstAfter s after founding, then every everyMin..everyMax s. warn s of warning (arrow + alert). With the hero within heroNear m the animals really come (spawned at the camp edge); otherwise the fight is resolved: defence = tower (towerPower x (1 + towerPerLevel x level)) + hunters x hunterPower (+specDefence for a hunting camp) vs threat = (threatBase + threatPerLevel x level + threatPerWave x wave) x wildMult x random(0.7..1.3). Lost fight: share (1 - defence/threat) of stockLoss of every good is lost and damage grows by damagePerLoss x that share. Damage slows the camp (x(1 - 0.7 x damage)); the camp mends itself with depot logs (repairPerLog per log every repairEvery s).
